narrative: Start with the REST entry point: `petclinic/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/owner/OwnerRestController.java` is a @RestController that exposes the Owner Registration endpoint. It builds and validates an `Owner` (`owner/Owner.java`), whose fields — including `telephone` — map onto the persistence schema in `resources/db/schema.sql` and the documented contract in `resources/openapi.yaml`. `owner/OwnerRegistrationTests.java` exercises this flow end to end. As a newcomer, read OwnerRestController first, then Owner, then confirm the field constraints against schema.sql and openapi.yaml — note these two sources disagree on telephone length, so treat that constraint as low-confidence until confirmed.

relation_notes.note: The controller instantiates and validates the Owner entity for each registration request; this is where request data becomes a domain object.
Owner.telephone is persisted to the owners table; the column definition sets the authoritative storage constraint.

The public request/response contract for the endpoint is documented here; use it to understand expected inputs. Insufficient evidence to confirm it matches the code exactly (telephone length differs).
